mapper.select: select r.id, r.user_id as userId, u.nickname, r.total_score as totalScore, r.submit_time as submitTime, r.status from exam_record r join sys_user u on u.id = r.user_id where r.exam_id = #{examId} and r.status in ('SUBMITTED', 'GRADED') order by r.total_score desc, r.submit_time asc limit #{limit}
select r.* from exam_record r join exam e on e.id = r.exam_id where r.status = 'ONGOING' and e.duration is not null and timestampadd(minute, e.duration, r.start_time) < now() limit 100
